name: 40660-imagechat-llama4scout-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8).
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one node.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, BF16: a 48-layer 16-expert MoE language model with a 34-layer 336-px vision tower. Full values are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, bounded at 100 requests with a 600 s safety cap, warmup 0.2. About 90 requests end up scored; read the exact count off request_latency.successful.count rather than deriving it.
workload: Synthesised in-process by guidellm, four data specs merged column-wise into ONE single-turn request: 484 text prompt tokens (min=max) and exactly 40 output tokens with ignore_eos, greedy, plus three 336x336 gradient JPEGs at quality 85 with seeds 40660/40661/40662. Three separate one-image specs and NOT `images_per_request: 3` -- guidellm's GenerativeColumnMapper reads a trailing `_<digits>` as a turn index, so one three-image spec becomes a three-turn conversation instead. The distinct seeds make the three images byte-distinct within a row, and row_index makes them distinct between rows. 336 is the checkpoint's own tile size, so each image is exactly one chunk and expands to 144 prompt tokens; the engine sees ~930 prompt tokens per request, not the declared 484.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant for shoppers comparing three product photos per request, brief replies, ten concurrent users, eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine command line for 40660-imagechat-llama4scout-8gpu. Nothing here is tuned.

model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 8

# The checkpoint's max_position_embeddings is 10485760, so this cap is not a formality:
# without it the engine sizes the KV cache against ten million positions and will not start.
max-model-len: 8192

# KEEP ON ONE LINE -- the config reader is line-based and skips indented lines, so
# re-flowing the mapping drops the key and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 3}

dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# PINNED, NOT DEFAULTS. Under the in-process backend used here the engine's usage context
# falls through to SchedulerConfig's own defaults, giving a different scheduler shape.
# Do not delete these as redundant.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
